about: The prologue (the first opening's picture, as Seedance 2.5 made it) with the words the user wrote on 2026-11-27, word for word. Halgakos talks them over a band (tools/cutscenes/prologue-mc.json); this file is the band's plan for a model that takes parts with their seconds (ElevenLabs Music, asked with --bare: no voices), and where the words fall on the picture. The parts are the picture's: 120 beats a minute, a bar is two seconds, three takes of thirty seconds.
title: Calculation, Translation, and Sloppy~♡
style: A bright, bouncy anime-opening pop instrumental, 120 BPM in 4/4: sparkling synths, chiptune blips, handclaps, a four-on-the-floor kick, slap bass. Playful, cheeky, pastel and sunny. About ninety seconds, with a clean ending.
tags: anime opening, j-pop, bright, bouncy, 120 bpm, sparkling synths, chiptune, handclaps, instrumental

positive: a steady groove that leaves room for someone talking over it

intro: a falling sparkle sweep and a short punchy build
verse: a light, bouncy groove: bass, claps and blips, the melody kept low
pre-chorus: a rising build with faster claps and a drum fill into the chorus
chorus: the full band, a big bright catchy hook
member: the band hits on the first beat and drops to drums and bass, with one bright stab at the end
break: the band drops out to a soft pad and finger snaps, then a drum fill back in
outro: the music falls to a soft sparkle and ends on one last chime
